verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single marketing line on the homepage claiming users can 'fine-tune every detail with visual controls and live preview,' which suggests some direct, non-prompt editing. Nothing documents selecting a specific element or which text, style, or layout properties can be edited. Missing for 10: documented element selection, specific text/style/layout editing controls, in-depth first-party docs on the visual editor, independent or hands-on corroboration.
